layouts.name: Milford Road Course
layouts.description: Draft configuration: Full outer loop, northern inner return and southern stepped bends; excludes the smooth southern bypass. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 4827.7 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.

sources.title: Configuration identification reference
sources.evidenceNote: Supports circuit identification only. Catalogue layout facts identify historical branch choices. No diagram coordinates are extracted, traced or copied.

sources.title: Aerial imagery for estimated road borders
sources.evidenceNote: Derived edge coordinates. Reusable imagery evidence: https://www.usgs.gov/centers/eros/science/usgs-eros-archive-aerial-photography-national-agriculture-imagery-program-naip. Image hashes, extents and extraction evidence are stored in the layout. Estimates remain unreviewed.
